svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of one contact hole beside a transistor gate, one above the other. Before the step a hole with sloping walls goes down through a thin flat oxide and a dotted glass to the doped silicon. After it a thin dark film covers the flat top, the walls and the bottom of the hole; it is thickest in the lower corners, where the walls close in.

svg.text: sputtered into the holes and over the field.
After: the Ti/TiN liner in the hole and on the field
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
